root_cause.text: The uacce sysfs read and write handlers for device isolation strategy invoked driver callback functions without validating their existence, causing a NULL pointer dereference when the callbacks were missing.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "accessing a non-existent callback function may cause the system to crash," and the patch fixes this by adding null checks in `isolate_strategy_show` (`if (!uacce->ops->isolate_err_threshold_read) return -ENOENT;`) and `isolate_strategy_store` (`if (!uacce->ops->isolate_err_threshold_write) return -ENOENT;`) before invoking the respective function pointers.
